title: Player ratings v4: v3 + a box-score (statistical plus-minus) prior - pre-declared tuning, selection, validation and sanity rules
declared_before: any v4 run on the dev seasons (2023-24, 2024-25), the holdout (2025-26) or the 2026-27 sanity tables; one pilot on the tuning season 2021-22 only (v3 reproduction: max |SSE diff| 2e-9; 6 EV settings and 5 PP/PK settings of the SPM prior) was run before this file to set the grids
why: owner (2026-10-02): v3 ranks Kiviranta (+0.9, 230th) above Rantanen (-0.5, 331st) and Makar 199th. On-ice RAPM cannot split credit between players who share most of their ice time (Rantanen 81% of EV time with MacKinnon in 2023-24, 73% with Johnston in 2025-26; Makar with MacKinnon / Toews) and v3 uses no individual production, so low-event fourth liners are credited by default. v4 adds the standard RPM / EPM remedy: a statistical plus-minus prior from individual box-score rates.
base: ratings v3 as shipped (bu/rapm/v3_prereg.json, out/v3_validation.json): D90 game recency (0.5 ** (games ago / 90), 0 beyond 246 games), role means by position x EV-usage tier (v_role 0.001), two stages (pre-season prior on the 5-game grid + in-season ridge, d - 2 days), PP / PK RAPM, FIN (prior 30 xG), expected TOI by state, impact = goals per 82 games above the position average. Recency, roles, FIN and TOI are NOT re-tuned.

features.source: bu/rapm/box.py: per (game, player) counts from the lake's play-by-play events (free NHL API data), the RAPM xG v2 source for individual xG, the v3 TOI table; the player's side from the game's roster spots; the player's own manpower state at the event (both goalies in); regular season + playoffs, games passing the on-ice check
ev_per60: reb_ev rebounds created (his shot on goal followed within 3 s by a same-team attempt, nothing in between)
rush_ev rush attempts (previous event within 4 s in his neutral / defensive zone)
fol_ev faceoffs lost (faceoff features 0 for defencemen)
all_situations_per60: pt_all penalties taken (power-play units: minor 1, double minor 2, non-fighting major 2.5; fighting, misconducts, penalty shots 0)
usage: toi_pk_gp (minutes per game, 5 pseudo games of the position mean)
features.weighting: every count and every second weighted with the same per-game D90 weight as the player's stints (pre-season: w(g + games ago at the season start); in season: w(games ago), games up to d - 2 days); as-of only, no leakage
features.shrinkage: rate = (weighted count + t0 x position-group rate) / (weighted seconds + t0), t0 = EV pseudo minutes (PP / PK 0.15 t0, all situations 1.2 t0)
features.standardisation: within position group (F / D): EV-seconds-weighted mean and SD of the shrunk rates over the stage-1 players, clipped at +-4 SD; the stage-1 standardisation is reused in stage 2

model.ev: o_i = mu_O[role] + z_i' beta_O[grp] + u_i, u_i ~ N(0, v_o); d_i = mu_D[role] + z_i' beta_D[grp] + e_i, e_i ~ N(0, v_d); beta ~ N(0, v_beta) per standardised feature, separate per position group and component; fitted JOINTLY with the players, role means and covariates in the stage-1 ridge on the weighted stints (the SPM is fitted on the on-ice stint outcomes themselves, not by a two-step regression on shrunken RAPM estimates)
model.pp_pk: pp_i = mu_PP[grp] + z_i' beta_PP[grp] + ., pk_i = mu_PK[grp] + z_i' beta_PK[grp] + . (v_pp, v_pk, beta ~ N(0, v_beta_st)) on the PP rows
model.stage2: in-season prior mean = stage-1 posterior mean + beta' (z(pre-season + this season) - z(pre-season)); a player without a stage-1 prior: role mean + beta' z(this season); then this season's stints ridged toward it exactly as in v3
model.penalties: not in RAPM: an impact term (below)

seasons.holdout_rule: one look after the dev run, the selected v4 configuration and the references scored in the same run, logged in bu/rapm/out/v4_look_log.jsonl; no parameter or rule change after it; reported whatever it is

primary_metric: v3's next-30-game EV stint MSE (bu/rapm/v3_validate.py, unchanged: as-of points g in {0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50} games per team, players fixed at the as-of ratings, covariates refit on the test rows, stint-seconds-weighted MSE of the attacking side's xG/60, date-clustered paired SEs); v4 rows pair one-to-one with the logged v3 (D90), window (shipped v2) and Kalman rows
secondary_metrics: next-season EV stint MSE (g = 0 ratings on the whole season)
PP next-30-game stint MSE and PP / PK slopes
game level: walk-forward log loss of the game model with bu_d_net / bu_d_delta / bu_d_fin rebuilt from v4 vs the live model

ev_grid.fixed: D90, role both, v_role 0.001, aging steps, PP / PK as v3 (spm_st off) while tuning EV

ev_selection_rule: lowest pooled tuning-season primary MSE over the 160 grid points. If the pick sits on a grid edge of v_beta, v_o or v_d, the next value beyond that edge (v_beta x 3 / 3; v_o, v_d +- 0.005, never below 0.005) is scored at the picked other values, once, and the lower pooled tuning MSE wins

st_grid.reference: spm_st off at v3's v_pp 0.16 / v_pk 0.08

st_selection_rule: with the selected EV configuration: lowest pooled tuning-season PP next-30-game MSE among the 36 SPM points and the reference
penalty_rule: rates of penalties drawn / taken per 60 all-situation minutes with the D90 weights, shrunk to the position-group rate with t0_pen pseudo minutes, t0_pen in {50, 100, 200, 400, 800, 1600}: lowest pooled tuning-season Poisson deviance of the next 30 games' penalty units (drawn + taken, as-of points as the primary metric). Value of a penalty unit = league net power-play goals (PP goals - shorthanded goals, both goalies in) per penalty unit of the last completed season (bu/rapm/box.pp_goal_value)

impact.formula: v3's impact_82 (EV OFF / DEF, PP OFF, PK DEF, FIN, each x expected minutes, k = goals per xG) + 82 x v_pen x TOI_all / 60 x [(pd60 - m_pd) - (pt60 - m_pt)], TOI_all = expected EV + PP + PK minutes per game, m = TOI_all-weighted mean of the rated roster skaters of the position group; drawn goes to off_impact, taken to def_impact (The Athletic's split)
impact.weights_rule: v3's: w_o = w_d = 1 if both pooled tuning-season EV calibration slopes of the selected configuration lie in [0.85, 1.15], else each slope clipped to [0.5, 1]; the same for (w_pp, w_pk) with the PP slopes

ship_rule: v4 replaces v3 as the site's player ratings only if the selected configuration's dev pooled (2023-24 + 2024-25) primary MSE is lower than v3's (paired point estimate < 0). The holdout look is reported; if v4 is worse than v3 on 2025-26 by more than 2 paired SEs, the export stays v3 and the owner decides. The PP / PK SPM ships only if its dev pooled PP MSE is lower than v3's PP / PK (else v3's PP / PK under v4 EV)
game_model_rule: the owner rule: the game model retrained with bu_d_net / bu_d_delta / bu_d_fin rebuilt from v4 is promoted only if its dev pooled walk-forward log loss is lower than the live model's (paired per game) and its single 2025-26 look is not worse than +0.0010 per game (logged in bu/lineup/out/look_log.jsonl, component 'Ratings v4 lineup term'); otherwise the live game model stays and only the site's player ratings (and the bundle's v4 table for the simulator) move

sanity_checks.status: a written CHECK LIST, not a fitting target: no hyperparameter, feature or rule of this file is chosen or changed because of it; evaluated once on the shipped configuration's 2026-27 season-start export (and on v3 for comparison) and reported pass / fail as is
sanity_checks.universe: current-roster skaters of the export (player_ratings.json rows with roster = true), ranked by impact
checks: MacKinnon, McDavid, Draisaitl, Kucherov, Matthews, Pastrnak, Rantanen, Makar, Q. Hughes each in the league top 50 by impact (9 checks)
Rantanen above Kiviranta, above Faksa, above Bäck (3 checks)
Kiviranta, Faksa, Bäck each below DAL's median roster skater by impact (3 checks)
Robertson, Johnston, Rantanen, Heiskanen, Hintz, Harley each in DAL's top 8 by impact (6 checks)

moneypuck_secondary: correlations (5on5 TOI-weighted, roster skaters with >= 300 5on5 minutes in 2024-25 + 2025-26, MoneyPuck free skater files): ev_off vs on-ice rel xGF/60, ev_def vs rel xGA/60 prevented, ev_off + ev_def vs the sum, ev_off + fin vs rel xGF/60 + GAx/60 (as v3); individual: impact and off_impact vs MoneyPuck all-situations points / 60 and gameScore / game; reported for v4, v3 and v2, not used for selection
descriptive: SPM coefficients per feature, component and position group at the 2026-27 season start (which individual stats matter)
credibility tables: league top 30, DAL full roster, named players
share of each player's impact from the SPM prior vs his own on-ice data
